name: school_white
about: The white school (the user's first photo, 2026-11-01): the four-storey classroom building of the school kit's set school_white walked into (every room at its real size inside: 8 × 7.2 m classrooms, a 2.4 m corridor, dog-leg stairs in shafts to a penthouse, the stair tower with round windows standing out at its east end), its name on the roof; a ribbed concrete wall and a blue sliding gate on the road, a notice board, two planters; the long low building beyond. Its shot `photo` frames it as the photo does.
